text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down fractionally over 24 hours despite extreme greed conditions, suggesting traders are consolidating gains rather than pushing higher right now. Bitcoin dominance at 58.8% and a healthy $122B in daily volume indicate the market structure remains stable even as sentiment peaks. The Fear & Greed index climbing 9 points over a week shows conviction is building, but the minor pullback across major assets hints at caution before the next leg.
